limits: Python and libraries on this page: the examples run in your browser, in Python 3.13.2 with Pyodide's Pillow 11.3.0 and Matplotlib 3.8.4, while the research ran Python 3.14.6 on Linux with Pillow 12.3.0 and Matplotlib 3.11.2. Each example that runs was compared with its recorded result by value (sizes, modes, pixel values, properties), not byte by byte, because the library versions differ.

Recorded, not run: 31 examples need the book's files (the zip, which is not embedded), a font file, a program of their own (a viewer, a child process), a real or virtual display, or print something that differs between the recording's libraries and the browser's (for example NumPy integer width in a bar chart, the type that pie() returns, the backend name); each is shown with its output recorded under Python 3.14.6, labelled 'Recorded, not run on this page', with its reason: BackendChoice, BarChart, BothSidesTest, ClipboardCopyPaste, ClipboardFailures, CornerPosition, CropBox, FigureDefaults, GetdataDeprecation, ImageFilename, ImageModes, LogoConstants, MaskedPaste, MissingFiles, OpenAndSize, OutputFolder, PasteInPlace, PasteMask, PieChart, ResizeInteger, RotateExpand, RotateFillClaim, SaveFormats, SeatingCards, ShippedScript, ShowLifecycle, ShowViewer, TextMeasuring, TileLoop, TkVersionNine, TrueTypeFont.

Pictures: 10 recorded pictures made by the research programs (BarChart, BoxTuple, ColorNames, DefaultFont, DrawingExample, LinePlot, PieChart, ScatterPlot, ShowLifecycle, TransposeFlip) are shown beside their examples, labelled 'Recorded picture, not made on this page'; they are SHA-256 checked when the page is made. Examples that run in the browser draw their own pictures where they show them.

The clipboard and viewer examples ran in the recording against a virtual X display (Xvfb) with the real xclip, viewer and Tk, not on a real screen; the Matplotlib window was not seen on a real screen. Nothing ran on Windows or macOS.

No wheel is embedded on this page and no file of the book's online materials (a zip of 7,759,877 bytes holding 91 files; zophie.png and catlogo.png are among them). The licence of the zip, of the cat picture and of the logo is an open question for the owner; pictures derived from them are not on this page (03-materials/ch21/assets/ASSETS_PROVENANCE_v1_0_0.md).

NOT EXECUTED: Windows and macOS (the Windows fill of rotated corners, the path C:\\folder_with_image_file, Paint and Photoshop); the text of the PDFs of the JPEG standard and of JFIF (reached, not searched); the commit the course pins; Python 3.14.7 and later and the final 3.15.0 (uv offered 3.15.0b4); the Matplotlib window on a real screen (a virtual display was used); and a photograph (the single request to Wikimedia Commons answered 429).

What the public sites answered on 2026-10-13 is in live_observations_v1_0_0.json: the chapter's page (status 200, 119,144 bytes, equal to the digest in the book's ontology) and the book's other pages and links. The book pins Matplotlib as matplotlib==3.92 in Appendix A, a release that does not exist; the study used 3.9.2 as the pinned environment.

One program was run under 11 interpreters (3.11.17, 3.12.3, 3.13.14, 3.14.0, 3.14.1, 3.14.2, 3.14.3, 3.14.4, 3.14.5, 3.14.6, 3.15.0b4): 0 of 35 items differ between them. The same chapter programs were also run under 14 Pillow releases (7 of 16 items differ, for example whether Image.open(...).filename is absolute, ImageDraw.textsize, getsize and getdata) and 14 Matplotlib releases (2 of 9 items differ: the default colour cycle and what pie() returns); see interpreter_record_v1_0_0.json. The 15 items of the third-party record were run with the newest releases and with the book's pins.
